title: Keep streaming voice configuration and cleanup invocation-local
summary: Resolve streaming settings per execution, preserve protocol boundaries and release all owned resources without hiding the primary failure.
hint_triggers: Resolve saved streaming preferences into typed invocation settings rather than mutating process.env. Pass streaming commands only to PCM streaming adapters: batch STT uses a different file-based protocol. Preserve explicit empty environment arguments when overriding saved defaults, use the canonical PCM sample-rate key, and probe the player actually selected. Admit streaming-only VAD after selecting a real bridge, and reject synthetic batch fallback when streaming fails. Own registration disposers, native processes and warm clients per loop; attempt every cleanup action while preserving the original operation error, including synchronous iterator-return failures. Validate configuration through the same schema and semantic checks for save and dry-run. Test source-identical code in an isolated checkout when a live daemon makes strict file-leak checks ambiguous; do not weaken the guard.
